items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: 'From the Shore of the Mighty Pacific' by Herbert Clark

ctx.x: Hokum, yeah, they called it hokum, because I know when -- this white boy I know, he came to St. Louis and told me to teach him some hokum. And he's teach me some legit. Well, I didn't have to be taught legit because I played all this triple time solos, 'Honeysuckle Polka' and 'From the Shore of the Mighty Pacific' by Herbert Clark, and 'Old Folks at Home' in three variations, so I didn't need -- I
felt that I didn't need anything else, because, see I was pretty well up there on the trumpet.
